verdict.rationale: Self-serve document automation is a fair question for a law firm with a legaltech practice, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows internal AI contract review and advisory work helping startups standardize their documents. Nothing shows an online, interactive document-assembly tool that clients can complete themselves.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates
